name: 0.1.0-beta.4
notes:
# Folian 0.1.0 beta 4

This beta completes the signed desktop update path and keeps project files separate from application updates.

- Adds production beta update discovery, download and restart-to-install support.
- Uses the remote AI model catalogue with validated offline fallback.
- Corrects project archive filenames when changing export formats.
- Preserves local projects, API keys, exports and backups during application updates.

Application updates replace only Folian itself. Your writing data remains in the separate Folian data folder.
